title: TechVault provider configuration record (v1)
description: Structural schema for Phase 1 closure (directive 82417). Placeholders only - never contains credentials. api_key_ref is an OS-keychain REFERENCE, never a key value.

provider.description: Registry ID of the provider adapter.

enabled.description: Enable/disable status. Placeholder records must be false.

base_url.description: HTTPS for cloud providers; plain HTTP allowed only for loopback (local providers such as Ollama).

api_key_ref.description: Opaque reference to the credential in OS secure storage. NEVER the key material itself. Literal placeholder: OS_KEYCHAIN_REFERENCE.

tts.description: Text-to-speech capability model (same provider integration, separate capability - API_POLICY 12.2).

additionalProperties.description: Future task slots use the same string form.

embedding.description: Embeddings are out of the initial release (R-011); flag exists for later phases.

connection_status.description: Changes only on an explicit user-triggered connection test; never probed automatically.
